title: A Liouville theorem for the two-dimensional stationary hypodissipative Navier--Stokes system
summary: We study the two-dimensional stationary incompressible Navier--Stokes equations on $\mathbb R^2$ with fractional dissipation $(-Δ)^s$. In the full range $s \in (0,1)$, we prove that every smooth solution satisfying the natural energy condition $u\in\dot{\mathrm H}^s(\mathbb R^2;\mathbb R^2)$ has $u\equiv0$ and constant pressure. This is a fractional counterpart of the planar finite-Dirichlet theorem of Gilbarg and Weinberger at $s=1$. The proof uses different arguments in three ranges.
